positions.title: Teaching Assistant - Introduction to Machine Learning
positions.description:
- Hosted multiple weekly office hours for 60+ students
- Explained concepts like: machine learning models, supervised and unsupervised learning, loss functions, gradient descent, backpropagation, Neural Networks and deep learning overfitting, regression and classification, clustering, gradient boosting, decision trees and random forests, and a brief introduction to Neural Networks and deep learning.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant - DATA25900
positions.description:
- Hosted multiple weekly office hours for 80+ students to answer questions and explain core data science concepts
- Explained key concepts such as: inferential statistics, Bonferroni corrections, data inputation methods, pre-processing, equalized odds, differential privacy, K-anonymity, Monte Carlo simulations, and Laplace mechanism
- Assisted students asynchronously through Ed Stem discussion posts 
- Worked with Professor Jotte and Professor Nussbaum to discuss grading frameworks and evaluate final project submissions
